tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for participating in this study today. I'd like to ask you some questions about your travel habits. First, can you tell me about a recent trip you or a friend took and what you or the friend enjoyed most about it?
tasks.sample: I'd like to talk about a trip my best friend took last summer. She went to a small coastal town in southern Italy. What she enjoyed most was the sense of being completely disconnected from her daily routine. She had no email, no social media notifications, just good food, beautiful beaches, and long walks. She told me her favorite moment was watching the sunset from a cliff while eating homemade gelato. It wasn't about visiting famous landmarks. It was about slowing down and actually relaxing. For her, that trip wasn't just a vacation. It was a mental reset.
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你今天参与这项研究。我想问你一些关于你出行习惯的问题。首先，你能告诉我你或一位朋友最近的一次旅行吗？在这次旅行中，你或这位朋友最喜欢的是什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. One important part of traveling is deciding to go alone or with a group. Thinking about a place you would like to visit, would you prefer to go there alone or with a group, why?
tasks.sample: I would definitely prefer to go alone. Here's why. When you travel alone, you have complete freedom. You can wake up late, change your plans last minute, or stay an extra day in a place you love without asking anyone else. I enjoy that kind of flexibility. Also, traveling alone pushes you out of your comfort zone. You have to talk to strangers, figure things out on your own, and solve problems by yourself. That's how you grow. Don't get me wrong, group trips can be fun too. But for me, solo travel is more meaningful because it's entirely your own experience.
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。旅行中很重要的一部分是决定独自出行还是结伴出行。想一个你想去的地方，你会更愿意独自去还是和一群人一起去？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. For many people, One of the most exciting parts of travel is choosing a destination. If you are going to select a place to travel, how would you go about making a list of potential places? Please describe your process.
tasks.sample: My process is pretty simple. First, I think about what I need from the trip. Am I looking for relaxation, adventure, or culture? That helps me narrow things down quickly. Then, I do online research. I watch travel vlogs, read blogs, and check out forums like Reddit. Real travelers give honest advice. I also ask friends who have been to places I'm curious about. After that, I compare costs like flights, accommodation, daily expenses. Finally, I pick two or three options and sleep on it for a few days. If I still feel excited about a place after a week, that's probably the one.
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。对很多人来说，旅行中最令人兴奋的部分之一就是选择目的地。如果你要选择一个旅行的地点，你会怎样列出一个潜在目的地清单？请描述一下你的过程。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Finally, one major issue with travel today is overcrowding. Popular places have so many tourists visiting at one time that the sites are unable to allow all the people to visit who want to. As a result, virtual travel experiences are becoming more common compared to real life travel. Do you think a virtual travel experience.
tasks.sample: No, I don't think virtual travel can replace the real thing. Virtual tours might give you nice visuals, but they can't give you the full experience. You can't feel the warm breeze on your skin, taste local street food, or hear the unexpected sounds of a busy market. Travel is not just about seeing, it's about being there. Also, the best parts of travel are often unplanned. Getting lost in a new city, having a random conversation with a local. Virtual experiences can't recreate those moments. So I see virtual travel as a nice supplement, not a replacement. It's like looking at a menu instead of eating the meal.
tasks.analysis: 中文：最后，当今旅行的一个主要问题是过度拥挤。热门的地方同时有太多游客参观，以至于那些景点无法容纳所有想去参观的人。因此，虚拟旅行体验相比于现实旅行变得越来越普遍。你认为虚拟旅行体验。
tasks.title: Interview
